name: Session Restore
author: David Reed
description: Save every open window — app, workspace, monitor, size, floating/fullscreen state, working directory, and browser tabs — as a named session. Restore it on demand, or pin one to reopen automatically at login (once per login; a mid-session shell restart will not re-fire it). Requires node >= 18, and python3 for browser tabs. Does NOT restore the tiled split arrangement within a workspace — see the README.

barWidget.description: Save your open apps and window layout as named sessions; reopen on demand from the panel or automatically at login. Restores workspace, monitor, size, floating state, and browser tabs — not the tiled split arrangement.
